subject: Mutual Action Plan: SentryMed geofence & hosting trade study
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@sentrymed.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Verma <priya.verma@sentrymed.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: SentryMed deployment options & region - initial MAP v2

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the time last week. Attached is our internal MAP draft (SentryMed_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short note on our priorities. High level: we need a plan that covers evaluation criteria, a POC path, and a target close timeline. Key constraints:

- PHI residency for EU patients (primary region would need to be eu-west); analytics can run in us-east for aggregated workloads.
- Procurement needs an initial outlay estimate to decide whether to pursue Dedicated or Private; Hosted is attractive for speed but raises governance questions for our legal/compliance team.
- Target: we want to lock the deployment mode and geo by end of August if feasible.

Can you propose an evaluation cadence and what extra evidence we should provide to our security team (SOC2 evidence, if available)? Also — can Redwood share a short doc comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for a mid-stage health SaaS (ballpark costs / SLA expectations)?

Suggested next step: a 30–45 minute scoping call with your solutions + sales to align the MAP and timeline.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Cloud Ops, SentryMed

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@sentrymed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: SentryMed deployment options & region - initial MAP v2

Amit —

Appreciate the clear priorities and the draft MAP. I pulled our internal owners into thread (Karthik: pricing/legal, Marissa: solutions/POC, Laura: product/integration). Quick read and proposed path below. I attached an annotated MAP with our comments (SentryMed_MAP_comments.xlsx).

Recommended MAP / evaluation approach (short):

1) Evaluation criteria (we'll submit formal rubric):
   - Latency (p95) for your 256-token inference paths
   - Throughput for batch scoring (embeddings/rerank)
   - Data residency & encryption proofs (KMS/HSM options)
   - Failover plan and regional fallback latency impact
   - Cost per 1M tokens + incremental storage for KV cache

2) Suggested POC sequence (min risk / fastest time-to-insight):
   - Week 0–2: Hosted PoC in us-east for feature dev (no PHI).
   - Week 3–5: Dedicated pilot in eu-west for PHI (isolated GPU pool, audit logging enabled).
   - Parallel: run our security checklist (link below) and hand evidence to SentryMed Legal.

3) Decision lanes:
   - If eu-west residency + strict audit needed => Private (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated with strong contractual SLAs.
   - If regulatory controls are standard HIPAA/SOC2 + you can live with cloud tenancy, Dedicated gives better economics and control.
   - Hosted makes the fastest path to results; we'll provide short anonymized benchmark artifacts to help your procurement.

4) Timeline (proposed):
   - Aug 9: kickoff PoC (hosted & security questionnaire start)
   - Aug 23: Dedicated pilot in eu-west online (if approved)
   - Aug 31: decision checkpoint (target close if procurement aligns)

Action items:
- SentryMed: confirm preferred PO window & earliest date to run eu-west PHI pilot.
- We: will prepare Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private one-pager and provide SOC2 summary + redacted audit artifacts.

Quick ask: can you share the top 5 data flows that would touch PHI (so we can map residency needs)?

Link: Security checklist (please fill): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSentryMedMAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SM-2027-0421

Best,
Chloe Martin
Product Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Amit Shah <amit@sentrymed.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Verma <priya.verma@sentrymed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: SentryMed deployment options & region - initial MAP v2

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear plan and timeline. A few clarifying notes from our side after reviewing the annotated MAP:

- We can do a hosted PoC for non-PHI quickly. Goal is to get dev teams unblocked.
- Procurement flagged that Dedicated looks preferable for production but will need a 60–90 day procurement window if we go dedicated (contract reviews + security addenda).
- If we go Private (on-prem) cost/ops complexity rises significantly — we need an order-of-magnitude estimate to show to the board.

Questions:
1) Can you provide a one-page TCO sketch: Hosted vs Dedicated (monthly) vs Private (one-time infra + ongoing ops)?
2) What SLAs do you typically offer for Dedicated (uptime / regional failover RTO)?
3) Is there a fast path to get SOC2 artifacts and redacted audit logs for their review?

We'll aim to start the non-PHI hosted PoC the week of Aug 9. For eu-west PHI pilot — earliest we can approve is Aug 23, subject to legal. I've looped Priya (security) and will add legal contact if things move.

Attached: internal procurement timeline (SentryMed_procurement_timeline.pdf).

–Amit
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@sentrymed.com>, chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: SentryMed deployment options & region - initial MAP v2

Amit / Chloe —

Short answers while we assemble formal artifacts: 

1) High-level TCO ranges (ballpark, per month):
   - Hosted (managed): $8k–$15k / month (depends on usage; includes runtime + metered tokens).
   - Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): $35k–$120k / month depending on pool size and model mix; annual reserved commit reduces per month materially.
   - Private (on-prem): one-time infra $300k–$1M+ depending on footprint; plus ops headcount ~1 FTE-equivalent and monthly infra ops.

2) Dedicated SLAs: 99.9% regional uptime for reserved pools; documented RTO for regional failover (we'll provide the formal SLA PDF).

3) SOC2 / audit artifacts: we can provide a SOC2 summary + redacted evidence bundles and a short security review pack within 48–72 hours of request.

Next steps:
- Chloe / Marissa will drop the Hosted vs Dedicated one-pager and annotated MAP by EOD today.
- I'd like to schedule a 30-min procurement + legal kickoff with SentryMed Legal next week (suggest Thu, Aug 12).

If SentryMed is leaning Dedicated but procurement window is long, the pragmatic lane is: start Hosted PoC now, then cutover to Dedicated once procurement completes. That path minimizes delivery risk while preserving commercial leverage.

Sharing: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SM-2027-0421

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
